### Workflow


```{r import-data}
result_StM16 <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "result_StM16.rds", package = "MS1Match"))

```

### Prepare the Feature Table

We now create a feature table by combining the output from `result_StM16[[2]]` (feature definitions) and `result_StM16[[3]]` (intensity values). The table is then cleaned and prepared for downstream annotation.

In particular:

1. Convert the result to a data frame (**required**)
2. Rename the first column to `feature_name` (**required**)
3. Remove the `peakidx` column (**optional**)
4. Calculate a new column `intensity_mean` as the row-wise mean across samples (**required** if using multiple samples)
5. Sort the table by RT or m/z (**optional**)
6. Filter by retention time using `dplyr::filter()` (**optional**)  
   – In this example, we keep features with RT between 60 and 1200 seconds.

```{r create-FT}
result_StM16_FT_filtered <- processFeatureTable(result_StM16, sample_cols = "mzxml", sort_by ="rtmed") #,rt_range = c(60,1200))

```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
head(result_StM16_FT_filtered)
```

Step 1: Create a `DirectLibMatch` object. It requires the feature table and library, and define matching parameters such as m/z tolerance, RT tolerance, and polarity:
```{r create-direct-libmatch}
truncated_DirectLibMatch_obj <- createDirectLibMatch(
  FT = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
  compounds_list = truncated_Si16_list,
  diff_mz_thr = 0.01,
  diff_rt_thr = 20,
  ppm = 10,
  ms_level = "MS1",
  polarity = "pos"
)





```





We can now annotate the feature table using the direct MS1 library match.

Run the library annotation process. By default, this also computes inner and outer cosine similarity scores and :
```{r}
#direct_match_Stm16_obj <- libAnnotate(DirectLibMatch_obj, compute_cosine = TRUE)

library(doParallel)

# Start a cluster using available cores
n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
# 
# # Register it so %dopar% uses it
 registerDoParallel(cl)


system.time(truncated_direct_match_Stm16_obj <- libAnnotate(
  truncated_DirectLibMatch_obj,
  compute_cosine = TRUE,
  ppm = 20
))




```
The result from `libAnnotate()` is a list containing matched annotations.

Retrieve the results using the `results()`` accessor:
```{r, results='hide'}
truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1 <- results(truncated_direct_match_Stm16_obj)

```

```{r}
truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1[[1]]
```






 You can convert it to a data frame for easier inspection:
```{r, results='hide'}

truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1_df <- results_df(truncated_direct_match_Stm16_obj, collapse_full = TRUE, remove_full = TRUE, suffix = "_merge")
head(truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1_df,50)


```


### Visualizing MS1 Spectral Matches
`MS1Match` provides visualization tools to help inspect the quality of spectral matches between query features and reference library compounds using mirror.
This function `plotMirrorSpectraSingle` creates a mirror plot using the matched feature peaks (on top) and reference library spectrum (on bottom).
The cosine similarity score (inner and outer cosine from `Spectra`) and the match score are displayed in the plot.
If no `output_dir` is provided, only the plot is shown. If `output_dir` is set, the plot will be saved as a PNG file instead.

```{r}
plotMirrorSpectraSingle(object = truncated_direct_match_Stm16_obj, match = truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1[[5]], output_dir = NULL)

#plotMirrorSpectraSingle(match = truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1[[5]], output_dir = NULL)

```



```{r}
truncated_direct_match_Stm16_res_MS1[[5]]
```





## Annotation of MS1-Matched Features



### Import Supporting Tables
We first import the adduct and neutral loss tables:
```{r import-supporting-tables, message=FALSE}
# Load adduct and neutral loss tables
adduct_table <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Adducts", "adducts.csv", package = "MS1Match"))

neutral_loss_table <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Neutral loss", "neutral loss database.csv", package = "MS1Match"), check.names = TRUE)
  


```




After identifying candidate features through direct MS1 library matching, we initialize a `PeakAnnotation` S4 object to annotate the features using adducts, neutral losses, and isotopic patterns
```{r}

# Create PeakAnnotation object
PeakAnnotation_obj_truncated <- createPeakAnnotation(compounds = truncated_Si16_list,
                                              FT =  result_StM16_FT_filtered,
                                             
                                              neutral_loss_table = neutral_loss_table,
                                              adducts_df = adduct_table,
                                              PI_rt_threshold = 10 ,
                                              polarity = "positive")
```

Finally, we call the `annotate` to generate detailed annotations:
```{r}
StM16_annotate_res_truncated <- annotate(PeakAnnotation_obj_truncated)
```
The output is a list which includes primary ion, adduct, neutral loss, and isotope annotations for each feature.
```{r, results='hide'}
# check output
StM16_annotate_res_truncated[[1]]
```


convert list to data frame

```{r, results='hide'}
annotate_peaks_StM16_result_df_truncated <- annotations_df(StM16_annotate_res_truncated)

```

### summary 


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)


summarize_redundant_features_refined <- function(df, ppm_tol = 10) {


  # --- helpers ---
  ppm_error <- function(obs, ref) abs(obs - ref) / ref * 1e6
  extract_pi_mz <- function(x) as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?i)([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)(?!.*[0-9])"))

  # Choice A (positive mode): any '-' inside [...] => treat as NL
  has_minus_inside_brackets <- function(x) {
    str_detect(x %||% "", "\\[[^\\]]*-[^\\]]*\\]")
  }

  # --- clean empty strings ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x)))

  # --- exclusive feature-level classification (so totals add up) ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      has_PI  = !is.na(PI_match_full) & str_trim(PI_match_full) != "",
      has_iso = !is.na(iso_annotation_full) &
        str_trim(iso_annotation_full) != "" &
        str_detect(iso_annotation_full, "\\[M\\+\\d+\\]"),
      has_NL  = (!is.na(NL_match_full) & str_trim(NL_match_full) != "") |
        (!is.na(adduct_match_full) & str_trim(adduct_match_full) != "" &
           has_minus_inside_brackets(adduct_match_full)),
      has_adduct_any = !is.na(adduct_match_full) & str_trim(adduct_match_full) != "",
      feature_class = case_when(
        has_PI ~ "PI",
        has_NL ~ "NL",
        has_adduct_any ~ "Adduct",
        has_iso ~ "Isotope",
        TRUE ~ "Unannotated"
      )
    )

  # --- group-level exclusive totals (these sum to n_features_total) ---
  group_totals <- df %>%
    group_by(Lib_group_full) %>%
    summarise(
      n_features_total        = n(),
      n_features_with_NL      = sum(feature_class == "NL"),
      n_features_with_adduct  = sum(feature_class == "Adduct"),
      n_iso_features          = sum(feature_class == "Isotope"),
      n_unannotated_features  = sum(feature_class == "Unannotated"),
      perc_unannotated        = round(100 * n_unannotated_features / n_features_total, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- compound map (one row per PI per group) ---
  compound_map <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(PI_match_full), str_trim(PI_match_full) != "") %>%
    distinct(Lib_group_full, PI_match_full) %>%
    mutate(PI_mz = extract_pi_mz(PI_match_full))

  if (nrow(compound_map) == 0L) {
    warning("No compounds with PI_match_full found.")
    return(group_totals)
  }

  # --- (optional but useful) valid adduct feature count per PI ---
  adduct_long <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(adduct_match_full), str_trim(adduct_match_full) != "") %>%
    select(Lib_group_full, feature_name, adduct_match_full) %>%
    mutate(adduct_split = str_split(adduct_match_full, ";\\s*")) %>%
    unnest_longer(adduct_split, values_to = "adduct_entry") %>%
    mutate(
      adduct_entry  = str_trim(adduct_entry),
      adduct_label  = str_extract(adduct_entry, "\\[[^\\]]+\\]"),
      adduct_ref_mz = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(adduct_entry, "([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\s*$")))
    )

  adduct_eval <- compound_map %>%
    nest_join(adduct_long, by = "Lib_group_full") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(adduct_long)) %>%
    mutate(
      adduct_ppm_vs_PI = ifelse(!is.na(adduct_ref_mz) & !is.na(PI_mz),
                                ppm_error(adduct_ref_mz, PI_mz), NA_real_),
      adduct_is_valid_for_PI = case_when(
        is.na(adduct_ref_mz) ~ NA,
        adduct_ppm_vs_PI <= ppm_tol ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    )

  adduct_summary_min <- adduct_eval %>%
    group_by(Lib_group_full, PI_match_full) %>%
    summarise(
      n_valid_adduct_features = n_distinct(feature_name[adduct_is_valid_for_PI %in% TRUE]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- final lean output ---
  final <- compound_map %>%
    left_join(group_totals, by = "Lib_group_full") %>%
    left_join(adduct_summary_min, by = c("Lib_group_full", "PI_match_full")) %>%
    mutate(
      n_valid_adduct_features = replace_na(n_valid_adduct_features, 0)
    ) %>%
    select(
      Lib_group_full,
      PI_match_full,
      n_features_total,
      n_unannotated_features,
      n_features_with_adduct,
      n_features_with_NL,
      n_iso_features,
      perc_unannotated,
      n_valid_adduct_features
    ) %>%
    arrange(Lib_group_full, PI_match_full)

  return(final)
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare tidy data
plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(Lib_group_full!= "Lib_group_13") %>% 
  mutate(
    Compound = str_trim(str_remove(PI_match_full, "\\s*\\[.*$"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    n_valid_adduct_features,
    n_features_with_NL,
    n_iso_features,
    n_unannotated_features
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_valid_adduct_features, n_features_with_NL, n_iso_features, n_unannotated_features),
    names_to = "Feature_type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_type = recode(
      Feature_type,
      n_valid_adduct_features = "Adduct",
      n_features_with_NL      = "Neutral loss",
      n_iso_features          = "Isotope",
      n_unannotated_features  = "Unannotated"
    )
  )

# Order compounds by total redundant features
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  mutate(total_features = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(total_features))



# Plot: x = compound name, y = feature count
bar_plot<- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(Compound, -total_features), y = Count, fill = Feature_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Compound",
    y = "Number of redundant features",
    fill = "Feature type" #,
   # title = "Overview of redundant feature annotations per compound"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Adduct"      = "#66c2a5",
      "Neutral loss"= "#fc8d62",
      "Isotope"     = "#8da0cb",
      "Unannotated" = "#bdbdbd"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(bar_plot)
```



```{r}
ggsave("Overview of redundant feature annotations per compound_full_range.png", bar_plot, width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare tidy data
plot_df_subset <- summary_tbl_subset %>%
  dplyr::filter(Lib_group_full!= "Lib_group_13") %>% 
  mutate(
    Compound = str_trim(str_remove(PI_match_full, "\\s*\\[.*$"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    n_valid_adduct_features,
    n_features_with_NL,
    n_iso_features,
    n_unannotated_features
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_valid_adduct_features, n_features_with_NL, n_iso_features, n_unannotated_features),
    names_to = "Feature_type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_type = recode(
      Feature_type,
      n_valid_adduct_features = "Adduct",
      n_features_with_NL      = "Neutral loss",
      n_iso_features          = "Isotope",
      n_unannotated_features  = "Unannotated"
    )
  )

compound_order <- unique(plot_df$Compound)


# Order compounds by total redundant features
plot_df_subet_arrange <- plot_df_subset %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  mutate(total_features = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(total_features)) %>%
  mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = compound_order))

# Plot: x = compound name, y = feature count
bar_plot_subset <- ggplot(plot_df_subet_arrange, aes(x = reorder(Compound, -total_features), y = Count, fill = Feature_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 130), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+

  labs(
    x = "Compound",
    y = "Number of redundant features",
    fill = "Feature type"# ,
   # title = "Overview of redundant feature annotations per compound"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Adduct"      = "#66c2a5",
      "Neutral loss"= "#fc8d62",
      "Isotope"     = "#8da0cb",
      "Unannotated" = "#bdbdbd"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(bar_plot_subset)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# === Full range dataset ===
plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
  filter(Lib_group_full != "Lib_group_13") %>%
  mutate(Compound = str_trim(str_remove(PI_match_full, "\\s*\\[.*$"))) %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    n_valid_adduct_features,
    n_features_with_NL,
    n_iso_features,
    n_unannotated_features
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_valid_adduct_features, n_features_with_NL, n_iso_features, n_unannotated_features),
    names_to = "Feature_type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_type = recode(
      Feature_type,
      n_valid_adduct_features = "Adduct",
      n_features_with_NL      = "Neutral loss",
      n_iso_features          = "Isotope",
      n_unannotated_features  = "Unannotated"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  mutate(total_features = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(total_features))

# === Subset (truncated range) dataset ===
plot_df_subset <- summary_tbl_subset %>%
  filter(Lib_group_full != "Lib_group_13") %>%
  mutate(Compound = str_trim(str_remove(PI_match_full, "\\s*\\[.*$"))) %>%
  select(
    Compound,
    n_valid_adduct_features,
    n_features_with_NL,
    n_iso_features,
    n_unannotated_features
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_valid_adduct_features, n_features_with_NL, n_iso_features, n_unannotated_features),
    names_to = "Feature_type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature_type = recode(
      Feature_type,
      n_valid_adduct_features = "Adduct",
      n_features_with_NL      = "Neutral loss",
      n_iso_features          = "Isotope",
      n_unannotated_features  = "Unannotated"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Compound) %>%
  mutate(total_features = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Compound = factor(Compound, levels = unique(plot_df$Compound)))
```


```{r}
# --- Shared color palette ---
fill_colors <- c(
  "Adduct"      = "#66c2a5",
  "Neutral loss"= "#fc8d62",
  "Isotope"     = "#8da0cb",
  "Unannotated" = "#bdbdbd"
)

# === Upper plot ===
p_upper <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(Compound, -total_features), y = Count, fill = Feature_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 125), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  #labs(y = "Number of redundant features", x = NULL, fill = "Feature type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# === Lower plot ==
p_lower <- ggplot(plot_df_subset, aes(x = reorder(Compound, -total_features), y = Count, fill = Feature_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 125), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  #labs(y = "Number of redundant features", x = "Compound", fill = "Feature type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# === Combine (mirror-style stacked plots) ===
combined_plot <- p_upper / p_lower +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.2))  # adjust relative panel sizes

print(combined_plot)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

FT_na_summary <- StM16_join_annotation_join_truncated %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Lib_group_full) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    # collect all unique, non-empty compound names (stripped of "[...]")
    compound_names = list({
      nm <- sub(" \\[.*", "", PI_match_full)
      nm <- nm[!(is.na(nm) | nm == "")]
      unique(nm)
    }),
    full_mz      = dplyr::n(),
    truncated_mz = sum(is.na(mzmed_truncated)),
    fraction     = truncated_mz / full_mz,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(compound_names) %>%
  dplyr::rename(compound_name = compound_names) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(truncated_mz)) %>% 
   dplyr::filter(Lib_group_full!= "Lib_group_13")



FT_na_summary
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

FT_na_plot_df <- FT_na_summary %>%
  mutate(non_na_rows = full_mz - truncated_mz) %>%
  select(compound_name, full_mz, truncated_mz, non_na_rows) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(truncated_mz, non_na_rows),
    names_to = "Status",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = recode(Status,
                    "truncated_mz" = "bigger",
                    "non_na_rows" = "smaller"),
    Percent = Count / full_mz * 100
  )

# Create order vector (descending non_na_rows)
compound_order <- FT_na_plot_df %>%
  filter(Status == "smaller") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  pull(compound_name) %>%
  unique()


FT_na_plot_df <- FT_na_plot_df %>%
  mutate(compound_name = factor(compound_name, levels = compound_order))
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  FT_na_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = reorder(compound_name, -Count, subset = Status == "smaller"),  # ✅ order by "smaller" count
    y = Percent,
    fill = Status
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("bigger" = "firebrick", "smaller" = "steelblue"), labels = c("bigger" = "Bigger m/z", "smaller" = "Truncated m/z")) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of Bigger m/z vs Truncated m/z",
    x = "Compound Name",
    y = "Percentage of Rows",
    fill = "Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

p
```
